name: Amaizumi Moriame Koyori no Mikoto
source: A deity who lived in Mitsurugi Shrine before it got destroyed. She proclaimed to be the protector of Amami. Due to circumstances, she became a freeloader at [url=/c83565]Tomoyuki's[/url] place. She's a second year and classmate of him as well.
